slots_and_copies.name: global_header
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Single copy; validated by sum-to-zero checksum then 8-byte magic compare in FUN_0802b7d0; on failure FUN_0802b82c rewrites the ROM default header via FUN_0802bc4c and re-clears both slots. FUN_0802b764 rewrites it only when RAM differs from EEPROM.

slots_and_copies.name: slot_0
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Independent save slot, not a backup. Loaded by FUN_0802bbe0(0), validated by FUN_0802bbb4 (120-word sum-to-zero); invalid slots have their 8-byte descriptor zeroed by FUN_0802bb44, valid slots are adopted. No generation/sequence comparison.

slots_and_copies.name: slot_1
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Independent save slot, not a backup. Loaded by FUN_0802bbe0(1), validated by FUN_0802bbb4 (120-word sum-to-zero); per-slot validity only, no newest-wins or mirroring.

checksums.name: header_sum16_negated
checksums.formula_detail: stored = (-(sum of preceding u16 words)) mod 2^16; validity: sum of all 12 u16 words mod 2^16 == 0. Words are little-endian in RAM (primitive FUN_0802bc28 sums RAM u16s) and big-endian/MSB-first in the .sav EEPROM image; LE reading of samples yields 0x01fe and is rejected. No seed, no CRC, no XOR.

checksums.name: slot_sum16_negated
checksums.formula_detail: Same primitive as header: stored last u16 at slot offset +0xEE = (-(sum of preceding 119 u16 words)) mod 2^16; validity: sum of all 120 u16 words == 0 (FUN_0802bbb4 via FUN_0802bc28(buf,0xF0)). Both samples are erased/invalid: sum=0xff8c, stored=0xffff, required stored for current content=0x0073.

io_driver_functions.notes: DMA3 transfer primitive: programs DMA source/destination/count (count|0x80000000 enable, per packet GBA map DMA3 at 0x040000D4/D8/DC; literal _DAT values unresolved), polls busy bit 0x8000. Used for both directions to/from EEPROM port 0x0D000000.

Read one 8-byte EEPROM block: address bitstream DMA to 0x0D000000 (addr_bits+3 halfwords), then 0x44 halfwords DMA back; reassembles 4 u16 MSB-first, reverse word order in block. Seed function in save_related_functions.c.
Write one 8-byte EEPROM block: expands address+4 u16 MSB-first, DMA addr_bits+0x43 halfwords to 0x0D000000, waits EEPROM ready bit0 with timer timeout (0x88 budget). Seed function.
Write wrapper calling FUN_08041264 with wait-for-ready=1.
Verify: read-back via FUN_080411a0 and compare 4 u16; returns 0x8000 on mismatch.
EEPROM type identification; argument 4 selects 4-Kbit descriptor (block count +4, address bits +8).
Access preamble: save bus registers, FUN_080410d8(4), return identified flag.
Mid-level read: byte offset/length >>3 to 8-byte blocks, up to 3 retries per block via FUN_080411a0.
Mid-level write: per block FUN_08041250 write + FUN_080413c4 verify, up to 3 retries.
Sum param_2>>1 RAM u16 words into 16-bit accumulator; the sole checksum primitive.
Load 24-byte header, require 12-word sum==0, then compare 8-byte magic.
Copy ROM default header template, store -sum at word 11 (offset 0x16), write via FUN_08012768(0,0x18).
Recompute header checksum in RAM, compare 24 bytes to EEPROM, write only if different.
Slot validity: FUN_0802bc28(slotbuf,0xF0)==0 stored to descriptor+0x2C.
Boot init entry (indirect caller outside corpus): validate header, on failure rewrite default header and write 8-byte zero clear markers at 0x18 and 0x108, then load slots via FUN_0802bb44.

open_questions: Semantics of header bytes 0x08-0x15, especially the coupled 0x0C (+1) / 0x10 (-1) pair and the 0xFFFF word at 0x14.
Gameplay slot-write function (populate 240-byte payload, set checksum at +0xEE, FUN_08012768 at slot offset) is absent from the 288-function corpus; no populated valid slot sample exists.

Literal RAM addresses behind _DAT_0802b7c0/_DAT_0802b800/_DAT_0802bc88 header struct and save-manager global (+0x18 slot buffer, +0x34 active pointer) are unrecovered Ghidra symbols; RAM mirrors therefore unresolved.
Direct callers of boot init FUN_0802b82c and state dispatch FUN_08022f5c are indirect (UNRECOVERED_JUMPTABLE) and outside the corpus.
Role of FUN_0801e358, the per-valid-slot post-load hook called by FUN_0802bb44, whose body is outside the corpus.
